import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Global style
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'Liberation Serif'],
    'font.size': 8,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.5,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.5,
    'xtick.major.size': 3,
    'ytick.major.size': 3,
})

# Colors (colorblind-friendly muted palette)
C_GRAY = '#8C9196'
C_TEAL = '#2A7F8F'
C_BLUE = '#3D6098'
C_DARK = '#2C3E50'
C_LIGHT = '#B0C4CE'
C_ACCENT = '#D4764E'

# --- Figure A: Ablation waterfall ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.4, 2.5), dpi=300)

modes = ['Unconstrained', 'Grammar\nonly', 'Semantic\nonly', 'Full (S1)']
dr_vals = [15.37, 14.84, 11.65, 0.93]
reductions = ['—', '↓3%', '↓24%', '↓94%']
colors = [C_GRAY, C_LIGHT, C_BLUE, C_TEAL]

bars = ax.bar(range(len(modes)), dr_vals, width=0.55, color=colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)

for i, (bar, red) in enumerate(zip(bars, reductions)):
    y_pos = bar.get_height() + 0.4
    if red != '—':
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, y_pos, red, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color=C_DARK)
    # Value on bar
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height()/2, f'{dr_vals[i]:.1f}%', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7, color='white', fontweight='bold')

ax.set_xticks(range(len(modes)))
ax.set_xticklabels(modes, fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel('DR (%)', fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(0, 19)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# Annotation for non-additivity
ax.annotate('3% + 24% ≠ 94%\n(non-additive)', xy=(3, 1.5), xytext=(2.1, 10),
            fontsize=6.5, fontstyle='italic', color=C_DARK,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_DARK, lw=0.7),
            ha='center')

plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_6/projects/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/artifacts/_project/paper/figures/fig_ablation_waterfall.pdf',
            bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
plt.close()
print("Figure A done")

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', 'Liberation Serif'],
    'font.size': 8,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.5,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.5,
    'xtick.major.size': 3,
    'ytick.major.size': 3,
})

C_TEAL = '#2A7F8F'
C_BLUE = '#3D6098'
C_DARK = '#2C3E50'
C_ACCENT = '#D4764E'

# --- Figure C: Deployment tiers ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.4, 2.5), dpi=300)

latency = [1.10, 1.18, 1.39]
violation = [0.21 + 1.4, 0 + 0.11, 0 + 0]  # DR + CF
labels = ['Greedy S1', 'Beam k=2', 'Beam k=4']
colors_pts = [C_ACCENT, C_BLUE, C_TEAL]
sizes = [60, 60, 60]

# Pareto front line (connecting the points in order of latency)
sorted_idx = np.argsort(latency)
pareto_lat = [latency[i] for i in sorted_idx]
pareto_vio = [violation[i] for i in sorted_idx]
ax.plot(pareto_lat, pareto_vio, '--', color=C_DARK, alpha=0.4, linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)

for i in range(len(labels)):
    ax.scatter(latency[i], violation[i], s=sizes[i], c=colors_pts[i], edgecolors=C_DARK, linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
    # Label placement
    if i == 0:  # Greedy S1
        ax.annotate(labels[i], (latency[i], violation[i]),
                    xytext=(-8, 8), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=6.5, color=C_DARK, ha='center')
    elif i == 1:  # Beam k=2
        ax.annotate(labels[i], (latency[i], violation[i]),
                    xytext=(0, 8), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=6.5, color=C_DARK, ha='center')
    else:  # Beam k=4
        ax.annotate(labels[i], (latency[i], violation[i]),
                    xytext=(0, 8), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=6.5, color=C_DARK, ha='center')

# Add detail annotations
details = [
    'DR≤0.21%, CF≤1.4%',
    'DR=0%, CF=0.11%',
    'DR=0%, CF=0%'
]
for i in range(len(labels)):
    y_off = -10
    ax.annotate(details[i], (latency[i], violation[i]),
                xytext=(0, y_off), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=5.5, color='#666666', ha='center', fontstyle='italic')

ax.set_xlabel('Relative Latency (×)', fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('Total Violation Rate (%)', fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(1.0, 1.5)
ax.set_ylim(-0.2, 2.2)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Arrow showing Pareto direction
ax.annotate('', xy=(1.02, -0.1), xytext=(1.12, 0.6),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_DARK, lw=0.6, ls='--'))
ax.text(1.015, 0.15, 'Pareto\noptimal', fontsize=5.5, color=C_DARK, fontstyle='italic', rotation=65)

plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_6/projects/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/artifacts/_project/paper/figures/fig_deployment_tiers.pdf',
            bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
plt.close()
